_about: Every player-facing line Claude adds or rewords in Landlordsector (Andrzej, 2026-11-16). text_review.py builds text.html from this list. id: the review page's key, never reused. version: the release that added or changed it. Example values in the line are shown as they appear in game.

lines.line: Commute: +32 from proximity to city center
lines.when: First line of the Commute tooltip on a home sheet (agent's screen and Real estate tab). The number is the home's own spot, 0 (outskirts) to 50. Homes next to the city center always show +50.
Title of the Upgrades row's tooltip on a home sheet. Below it, what all the built upgrades do together.

lines.line: Jana Okoye threw a party at Leafy Cottage. It left a few scuffs.
lines.when: Housewarming tenant event, in the home's log (the home loses 1% condition).

lines.line: A service you hired is no longer offered and was cancelled.
lines.when: Home log, once, when you load a save where that home had the Night watchman.
